none: PAS CAM-5D6957: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.6g, diameter is 18mm
